name: trance-credit-displaces-ml34-baseline
note: A/B twin of trance-credit-displaces-ml34 with NO credit declared. Pinned so the guard asserts the credit's EFFECT (a freed slot, a higher Combat Mastery) rather than two unrelated numbers, and so R3 — an undeclared build solves exactly as before — is pinned against the real catalog.

name: trance-credit-displaces-ml34
note: declared stat credit (U1) — a Battle Trance's Insight Combat Mastery. Insight CM caps at 6 in the dataset, so a declared 7 beats every Insight-typed item: the bucket resolves to the credit, the gear goes zero-marginal, and the tie-break frees its slot for the next priority. Pins R5 + R6 against the real catalog.

name: trance-credit-additive-ml32
note: declared stat credit (U1) — Might's Reward's Sacred Positive Spell Power. No item in the catalog carries Sacred-typed Devotion, so the credit occupies an empty bucket: the total rises by exactly the credit and the loadout is untouched. Pins AE4, the case where a credit must NOT disturb the build.

name: trance-credit-additive-ml32-baseline
note: A/B twin of trance-credit-additive-ml32 with NO credit declared. The additive case must raise the total by exactly the credit and leave every slot alone; that is only checkable against this baseline.
